title: Layout composer for tidyplots
text: Now lets try real absolutely sized plots.  note, several alignment issues 🙃 E/F neither align upper edge /B lower edge C/D C align left edge G align left edge /C tags /B C/D height Can global alignment based plot panels? allow plots aligned top left bottom left. extensively, one offer: Horizontal alignment: left, right, center, justified Vertical alignment: top, bottom, center, justified Can maybe achieved spacers? left : (, B, C, NULL) right : (NULL, , B, C) center : (NULL, , B, C, NULL) justified : (, NULL, B, NULL, C) meantime, can fix layout “freeing” plots span multiple rows columns, adding spacer push C/D left.
code: library(tidylayouts)  row(p1, p2) |>    add_below(row(p3, p4)) |>    add_right(p5, p6) |>    add_below(p7) tidyplots_options(   width = 25,   height = 25,   my_style = function(x) { x |> remove_legend()}   )  p1 <- study |>   tidyplot(x = group, y = score, color = dose) |>   add_mean_bar(alpha = 0.3) |>   add_sem_errorbar() |>   add_data_points() |>   add_test_asterisks(hide_info = TRUE) p2 <- time_course |>   tidyplot(x = day, y = score, color = treatment, dodge_width = 0) |>   add_mean_line() |>   add_sem_ribbon() p3 <- energy_week |>   tidyplot(x = date, y = power, color = energy_source) |>   add_areastack_relative() p4 <- energy |>   tidyplot(y = energy, color = energy_source) |>   add_donut() p5 <- climate |>   tidyplot(x = month, y = year, color = max_temperature) |>   add_heatmap() |>    adjust_size(height = 55) p6 <- gene_expression |>    tidyplot(x = sample, y = external_gene_name, color = expression) |>    add_heatmap(scale = "row") |>   sort_y_axis_labels(direction, -padj) |>    adjust_legend_title("Row Z-score") |>    adjust_size(height = 55) |>    remove_x_axis_title() |>    remove_y_axis_title() |>    remove_legend() p7 <- gene_expression |>    head(100) |>    tidyplot(x = sample_type, y = expression, color = condition) |>    add_violin() |>    add_data_points_beeswarm(white_border = TRUE) |>    adjust_x_axis_title("") |>    remove_legend() |>    add_test_asterisks(hide_info = TRUE, bracket.nudge.y = 0.3) |>    adjust_y_axis_title("Gene expression") |>    split_plot(by = external_gene_name, nrow = 1)  tidyplots_options() row(p1, p2) |>    add_below(row(p3, p4)) |>    add_right(p5, p6) |>    add_below(p7) |>    layout_tags("A") row(p1, p2) |>    add_below(row(p3, p4, NULL)) |>    add_right(p5 |> adjust_size(height = NA),              p6 |> adjust_size(height = NA)) |>    add_below(p7 |> adjust_size(width = NA)) |>    layout_tags("A")
